text: elaine (docs): Hey — getting a 404 from an external FAQ link in the onboarding KB (https://kb.redwood.ai/onboarding/faq#billing-backlinks). Can someone who owns the onboarding guide take a quick look? sam (eng): I can take a look in a minute. Which exact link is 404ing? elaine (docs): The internal anchor `#billing-backlinks` on the FAQ page. User repro: clicks "backlinks" in the billing section and it lands at top of page instead of the anchor. link-bot: Automated scan result: docs/onboarding/faq.md -> contains anchor `billing-backlinks` but rendered id is `billing_backlinks`. Possible anchor normalization mismatch. sam (eng): ah yep, we changed the header text recently so the auto-generated ID swapped '-' -> '_'. Quick fix is either update the link to `#billing_backlinks` or add explicit HTML anchor. maggie (pm): @sam would prefer we keep canonical anchors with hyphens. Can we add an explicit anchor tag so older links keep working? sam (eng): yeah. plan: add `` above the header and add a tiny test in the CI smoke check. I'll open a PR. elaine (docs): sounds good. can you drop the PR here and we'll do a docs review? sam (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — includes anchor and a one-line test in scripts/linkcheck.sh. cc @maggie @sujan sujan (oncall): quick question — is there any customer-facing redirect we should add instead? we saw a handful of external 404s in last 24h for onboarding anchors. maggie (pm): if it's just anchors, let's avoid redirects. patching the doc is fine. but if we see many external refs broken we can add shortlink redirects later. elaine (docs): review done, small nit fixed. LGTM. sam (eng): merged and deployed to staging. command I ran: `make docs-build && ./scripts/linkcheck.sh staging` — all anchors pass now. link-bot: Deploy bot: docs-staging deployed at 2026-03-19T14:12:22Z. elaine (docs): thanks all.
